title: Tracks prepare in the background while you browse menus
summary: When Select Track, the race setup, a Single Player row leading to either, or a Championship row rests on a course for 800 ms, the game now prepares that course in the background (PR #513, issue #453). It downloads the course at low priority and decodes it on workers into the decoded-course cache. A selection change or Start supersedes the preparation, only one course is prepared at a time, and this is web only.
details: Limits: preloading is refused with data saver on, on 3g or slower connections, and on devices reporting 2 GB of memory or less. At most 6 courses are prepared from scratch per page, and 1 on cellular. Host measurements (M4, headless Chromium, local server, ENV01; not phone measurements): load takes 1.81-1.88 s cold with no preload and 1.01-1.05 s after preload. Key press to ride takes 1.97-2.48 s without preload versus 1.18-1.22 s with it. With a x4 CPU throttle, load takes 5.50-5.62 s versus 3.91-4.01 s. Tested locally; production verification follows the deploy.
limitation: The sound bank, race CPU vehicles, Freestyle objective and mini-game overlays are not preloaded. Safari and Firefox do not report memory or connection type, so only the cache budget applies there. No phone measurement yet.
